# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated yet: country of production is missing

| Required input | Status |
|---|---|
| (a) CN code | ✅ 7201 (pig iron and spiegeleisen), listed in the table |
| (b) Country of production | ❌ **Not provided** |
| (c) Quantity | ✅ 1,000 t |

The ruleset selects the default SEE by both CN code and country. The table has three different values for CN 7201:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|
| Türkiye | 1.85 |
| China | 1.66 |
| India | 2.53 |

Without the country, the correct factor can't be identified. The ruleset says not to estimate when a required input is missing, so I have not chosen a factor or averaged them.

**Please provide the country of production** (Türkiye, China or India). The calculation will be:

> Embedded emissions = Default SEE (country) × 1,000 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

If the country is not one of these three, the table has no default value for it, and the emissions can't be determined under this ruleset.
